name: Boracay Island 360 Marathon 2027
short_description: Boracay Island 360 Marathon 2027 is on Sunday 30 May 2027 at Bulabog Beach on Boracay Island in Malay, Aklan, over 5 km, 10 km, 21 km and 42 km.
ai_summary: Boracay Island 360 Marathon 2027 is held on Boracay Island, Malay, Aklan, and the MyRunTime registration page names Bulabog Beach as the venue. Distances are 42 km, 21 km, 10 km and 5 km. Start times and the 2027 route have not been published on the pages checked.
